name: Dynamic Crisis Hedge (deep)
description: Crisis-triggered overlay that dynamically selects the best-fast-trend defensive asset (VUTY/SGLN/COMM) when equity anchor (VUSA/IWRD) falls below its SMA. Carves hedge budget from equity sleeve and allocates to selected defensive(s), inverse-vol weighted. Based on Harvey et al 2019: during crises, the working defensive asset varies; fast momentum identifies it in real time. Deeper hedge allocation (40%) for stronger crisis protection. Expected: overlay leaves calm-period returns unchanged and improves crisis-period performance; portfolio Sharpe +0.1–0.2, max-DD reduction 20–35%.
